posts.title: How I Livetweeted .NET Conf Without Watching (All of) It
posts.description: I had an agent watch the .NET Conf 2026 live stream, process the talks in 2-minute chunks, and livetweet summaries to X, Bluesky, and Mastodon on my behalf for all four days. Here is why I did it, how the pipeline worked, and what I learned.
